item.title: Kaiser nurses say AI, workplace surveillance are making their jobs, care worse
item.description:

item.title: I Started a "Dirt Notebook"
item.description:
📝 I started a "dirt notebook" 13 Jul, 2026 I love taking notes, but one problem that I have is that that I start cherishing every notebook that I start. I've nicknamed it "The Drainage Channel", because it's just a place for whatever is going through my head right in that moment. It's been interesting going back at the end of the week and re-discovering thoughts or things that I had almost forgotten about again.
🔗 Read more: https://pinewind.bearblog.dev/i-started-a-dirt-notebook/

item.title: Open Source is not immune to monopoly
item.description:
📝 When any project becomes a monolithic tangle, it becomes enormously expensive—impossible even—to fork. To keep the ecosystem healthy, such projects must be broken into interoperable pieces that are small enough that it becomes tractable for a small group of people to fork one component at a time. tl;dr: When an organization or project becomes “too big to fail”, that is a sure sign that it should be broken into smaller pieces, and that includes OSS.
🔗 Read more: https://humancode.us/2026/07/17/open-source-monopoly
